title: Access policy for digital product passport attributes
description: Assigns one access class of https://w3id.org/soya/dpp-access/v1 to data elements of a passport, addressed by their path of element identifiers. The header attributes of EN 18223:2026 Table 1 are always public and cannot be classified.

id.description: Identifier of this policy, a URL. A changed policy gets a new identifier.

scheme.description: The vocabulary the classes are taken from.

default.description: Class of an attribute no rule reaches. Without it, such an attribute is authority.

path.description: Element identifiers from the top level down, separated by '/'. A rule on a collection applies to everything below it that no deeper rule reaches.

accessClass.description: Notation or IRI of a concept of https://w3id.org/soya/dpp-access/v1.
